punchline: The loop that makes savings snowball is exactly the same loop that makes a decline speed up.
thirty_sec: Donella Meadows compares two everyday things. A thermostat keeps pulling a room back to its setting, the way hot coffee always cools to room temperature. Money in the bank does the opposite: interest earns more interest, so it keeps growing on itself. One kind of loop resists change, the other amplifies it. And the amplifying kind works just as well in reverse, turning a small slide into a fast one.
question: Can you think of something in your life that got easier, or harder, the more it happened?
